maps: Original 32 held-out maps (base seed 501000), used here as a diagnostic set, not a new validation set
paired_state_selection: For every non-goal episode, final attempted planning state and last primary-feasible planning state, unique per episode. State/history are frozen before comparing all four methods.
measurements: primary minimum signed inflated clearance (capped at 30 m)
selected continuation minimum signed inflated clearance
distribution_shift: All primary-feasible selected candidate features during replay, compared descriptively with the original all-feasible-candidate training marginal ranges. This includes selection bias and is not causal evidence.
timing: No runtime comparison: diagnostics may overlap independent training tasks
causal_scope: Numerical and disturbance counterfactuals hold initial state and executed command fixed; alternative-choice comparisons hold state and command history fixed. They do not establish closed-loop safety or optimality.
posthoc_yaw_rate_probe: In addition to the four prespecified comparisons, mask only geometry-model input column11 at paired failure states. Training input11 is identically0. No state/control-generation changes; no claim of new held-out performance.
posthoc_shared_prefix_probe: For each of128 original map-condition tasks, replay Geometry and No-geometry identically until their first different executed control; compare task cost and margins at that common state. Designed after late-state probes showed mainly identical decisions; descriptive posthoc mechanism analysis.
